publisher: The Diary Of A CEO（Steven Bartlett）
label: 影片 18（上）
theme: Druski：童年、原諒與大學宿舍裡的頓悟
themeEn: Druski: They're Lying To You About Overnight Success! (Part 1)

ex.en: So I would always try to step in to try to be like a coping mechanism for him. Maybe it's my mom.
ex.zh: 所以我總是會想介入，試著成為他的一種調適方式。也可能是我媽。

fam: coping adj. 應對的（coping mechanism 調適機制）

tips.t: cope with stress／a problem 應付壓力／問題（TOEIC 同義：deal with、handle）。

ex.en: So, I I guess as a child, very perceptive children, you you're you're on edge a little bit then. For sure.
ex.zh: 所以我猜你小時候是個非常敏銳的孩子，那時候你會有點緊繃。沒錯。

tips.t: on edge＝緊繃不安；a perceptive analysis 有洞見的分析。

ex.zh: 他們會變成最有同理心的人。

tips.t: show empathy for customers 對顧客展現同理心（客服題常見）。

ex.en: He was diagnosed with schizophrenia and bipolar disorder as we continued to go through puberty and got older.
ex.zh: 隨著我們進入青春期、年紀漸長，他被診斷出思覺失調症和雙極性疾患。

fam: diagnosis n. 診斷（複數 diagnoses）

tips.t: be diagnosed with 被診斷出～；diagnose a problem 找出問題所在（技術維修也用）。

ex.en: Grudges can really hold a lot of weight on you.
ex.zh: 怨恨真的會讓你背負很重的包袱。

tips.t: hold a grudge against 對～懷恨在心。

ex.en: And I and I kind of feel that way like people like oh it's not too much of a burden on you in your career.
ex.zh: 我也有點這種感覺，大家會說：喔，你的事業對你來說壓力不會太大吧。

tips.t: financial burden 財務負擔；reduce the burden on staff 減輕員工負擔。

ex.en: And uh one of the things that will give you is great resilience, I imagine.
ex.zh: 我想，這也會給你很強的韌性。

tips.t: build resilience 培養韌性；a resilient economy 有韌性的經濟。

ex.en: So, I I one of the lessons I inherited was that relationships look like this and this isn't necessarily a great thing that I want, right?
ex.zh: 所以我繼承到的其中一課是：感情就是長這樣，而這不一定是我想要的好東西，對吧？

tips.t: inherit a business／a project 接手一家公司／一個專案。

ex.en: If I spoke to someone that you were in a relationship with and I said to them, "Is Drew affectionate?" You laughing. You know the answer.
ex.zh: 如果我去問和你交往過的人：「Drew 會很深情嗎？」你在笑。你知道答案。

tips.t: be affectionate toward 對～很親暱。

ex.en: So, I spent like a year and then another half of a semester there and I got my enough credits to transfer. Mhm.
ex.zh: 我在那裡待了大概一年又半個學期，修到足夠的學分可以轉學。嗯。

tips.t: the fall／spring semester 秋季／春季學期。

ex.en: So, I spent like a year and then another half of a semester there and I got my enough credits to transfer. Mhm.
ex.zh: 我在那裡待了大概一年又半個學期，修到足夠的學分可以轉學。嗯。

tips.t: transfer credits 轉學分；give someone credit 歸功於某人；store credit 購物抵用金（退貨題）。

ex.en: And for some reason, it always was a hassle for me to link up with them.
ex.zh: 但不知道為什麼，要約他們總是很麻煩。

fam: hassle-free adj. 省事的，無麻煩的

tips.t: hassle-free returns 輕鬆退貨（廣告常見）；link up＝碰面、會合。

ex.en: And that and that's when I just had like a I don't know what they would call like epiphany, you know.
ex.zh: 就在那時候，我有了一種……我不知道他們怎麼稱呼，頓悟吧，你知道。

tips.t: have an epiphany 恍然大悟（＝aha moment）。

ex.en: I'll buy as much as I could get to be able to stay in the room and not go out and socialize with all these people at this huge school.
ex.zh: 我會盡量買，好讓我能待在房間裡，不用出去跟這所大學校裡的人社交。

tips.t: socialize with colleagues 和同事交流（員工聚會題）。

ex.en: I thought that about like being an entrepreneur.
ex.zh: 我對當創業家也有這種感覺。

tips.t: a successful entrepreneur 成功的創業家；start-up 新創公司。
